propositions: A detached compaction sweep that dies between rename and git commit leaves the tracker working tree dirty (tracked deletions + untracked snapshot/retired files), which aborts the next reconverge merge and strands commits

Compaction fold must be crash-atomic via an intent journal written before mutation, ordered mutation with rollback on failure, and startup recovery that discriminates between landed, abandoned, and transient-fault journal states

Recovery must never lose folded events: incomplete rollback retains the uncommitted snapshot as SNAPSHOT_INCONSISTENT, and recovery clears journals for landed/superseded folds without reverting ticket files
Transient git faults (index.lock, timeout) must be distinguished from permanent snapshot absence so recovery does not misclassify a transient failure as a landed fold and incorrectly revert it
Per-ticket commits inside the fold's locked section eliminate the dirty-window exposure of an entire uncommitted batch from a killed sweep
